name: Ironcast Dead
_source: Monster Sheet (2 pages), AI/BP/Routine card sheet, Signature card image — owner scans 2026-11-15; Clash Setup: Principality of Stone Codex p.46–47 (Ironcast Dead Clash)

footprint.rear: the single cell directly behind (R on the sheet diagram)

basicAbilities.name: Interval Spawn
basicAbilities.rule: Rulebook p.62: Trait 토큰 누적 후(Necrofusion: Wound 3) 현재 행동 해결이 끝나면, Escalation 덱의 가장 낮은 레벨 BP를 Mob track 가장 왼쪽 빈 칸에 놓고 Mob을 배치, 가장 많은 기사를 향함. track이 가득하면 무효.

levelsNote: Level box: To Hit, Wounds, Exhibition Wounds, Activations (1 AI + 1 Signature token on the Mob track). Bonus row: starburst-arrow = Escalations at start of Clash, ribcage = AT bonus, V = Vigor Loss bonus. Rosegraal uses levels 1–3; level 4 Traits (Armored Dead, Lifeless Army) are transcribed but not implemented.

traits.name: Necrofusion
traits.text: Each time an Ironcast Dead is dealt a Wound (a Double Wound is treated as 2 Wounds), place a Generic token on this Trait. After resolving the current action, if there are 3 or more Generic tokens on this Trait, discard all tokens and Spawn an Ironcast Dead on an empty space of a Rubble Terrain tile closest to the [Priority Target] Priority Target. That Ironcast Dead immediately performs Signature.

traits.name: Armored Reawakening
traits.text: The Ironcast Dead that Spawn during the Clash gain an Armor [Armor] token.

traits.name: Armored Dead
traits.text:
When you deal a Wound to an Ironcast Dead with at least 1 Armor [Armor] token, place all of its Armor [Armor] tokens on the space it occupied. Treat Armor [Armor] tokens on the Clash Board as Rubble Terrain tiles. When a Mob moves onto or through a space with an Armor [Armor] token on it, place it on that Mob’s BP. A Knight on or adjacent to an Armor [Armor] token may, as a free action, test Might [Might] (7+) to remove that token from the Clash Board.

End of Knight Round: Remove 1 Armor [Armor] token from each space with Armor [Armor] tokens on the Board. When you remove the last Armor [Armor] token from a single space, Heal 1 (place the new Mob on that space).

traits.name: Lifeless Army
traits.text:
Ignore during the first Round.

Ironcast Dead additionally have Odd Spawn. Before each Activation: Spawn an Ironcast Dead on an empty space of a Rubble Terrain tile closest to the [Priority Target] Priority Target, that Mob immediately performs Gangup 1 against the [Priority Target]. If you cannot Spawn an Ironcast Dead, immediately perform Routine instead.
